metadata.title: Two Threads, One Week: The Work Log
metadata.register: Conversational-Balanced (matches the af_bella / @HumanitariansAI precedent set on the ai-support-shift reel, not the house Teardown register)
metadata.note: v2 revision, per user request: (1) added a presenter intro beat (B01, replacing the prior PROBLEM/B01_TwoThreads beat) — 'Hi, I'm Agrima' + what this week covered; (2) dropped the audit()/tally/'no overclaiming' framing from the CODE+revision arc — the script is now weekly_log_v1.py -> weekly_log_v2.py, a genuine LOG (every real item + status, revision adds a per-thread standout headline) rather than a done/pending honesty audit. All 8 real items (2 articles + 6 Loon Project items, 3 done/3 in-progress) are still shown — nothing hidden — but the video no longer leads with or dwells on the pending count; narration and B08/B10 drop the numeric 'shipped' tally entirely. Both scripts are real and were actually run to capture the OUTPUT beats' transcripts.

skin_warnings: B00: palette=claude but the cold open is 'ClaudeComposerAsk916' — COLD OPEN LAW wants ClaudeComposerAsk
END: palette=claude but the outro is 'un-annotated' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

metadata.reformat: center-cut, focus-aware; pantry/<bid>-916.* is the human replacement slot; -916 overrides honored

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — ask shown answered
beats.narration_text: Let's skip the usual highlight-reel recap. Two AI articles, and hands-on progress on the Loon Project — here's the actual log of this week, built for real.

props.command: claude "show me, with real code, a log of what I actually worked on this week — two AI articles, and the Loon Project's drone research and social strategy"

beats.role_note: presenter intro, replacing the PROBLEM framing — the log's premise IS the why (per user request)
beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Agrima. This week split two ways: writing about AI, and hands-on work for the Loon Project, tracking Minnesota's common loons by drone. This is the real log of what I worked on — not a highlight reel.
beats.visual_intent: presenter card: name, then a short summary of the week — sets up the whole video's spine

beats.narration_text: Start simple: ask Claude for a script that just logs what happened this week, thread by thread.

props.command:
claude "write weekly_log_v1.py — log this week's real work
  across two threads, writing and the Loon Project"

beats.narration_text: Here it is — one dict per thread, and a log function that just prints each item with its real status. No scoring, no tally. Just what happened.

props.title: weekly_log_v1.py

beats.role_note: OPEN vox slot → Manim, the REAL captured transcript
beats.narration_text: Run it. Two articles, published. Six items on the Loon Project side — three done, three still in progress. Honest, but it reads like a data dump, not something you'd actually want to read.
beats.visual_intent: two log columns — WRITING and LOON PROJECT, every item with its real status — from the REAL run of weekly_log_v1.py

beats.narration_text: So ask for the real fix: turn it from a data dump into something that reads like an actual log — and call out the week's standout from each thread.

props.command:
claude "update weekly_log_v1.py -> weekly_log_v2.py:
  -> turn the dump into an actual log — ordered,
     readable, one line per entry
  -> call out this week's standout from each thread"

beats.narration_text: The diff: a standout line up top per thread — the week's actual headline — then every entry underneath, in order. Still every item, still every real status. Just readable.

props.title: weekly_log_v2.py
props.sparkLine: Read like a log, not a spreadsheet.

beats.role_note: OPEN vox slot → Manim, the REAL captured transcript
beats.narration_text: Run it again. Same two threads, same eight real items — now with a standout up top: the fashion piece, and the drone finally in hand. Nothing hidden, nothing inflated. Just an actual log.
beats.visual_intent: the SAME two log columns, now each with a standout headline above the entries — from the REAL run of weekly_log_v2.py

beats.role_note: the lesson, stated plainly — no hype
beats.narration_text: That's the week, logged. Two articles out — one on AI reshaping fashion's forecasting and design, one on the open-source model gap closing. And real ground on the Loon Project: a drone in hand, the FAA path researched, a strategy for reaching lake communities and birders written — certification, footage, and a trained model still in progress. Not a highlight reel. Just the log.
beats.visual_intent: two cards — WRITING and LOON PROJECT — restated, closing with 'not a highlight reel, the actual log'

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — prompt read aloud AND discussed
beats.narration_text: Your turn. List what you actually worked on this week, in order, and ask Claude to turn it into a log — not a highlight reel, just what happened, with a standout per thread.

props.command:
claude "here's my week: [what I actually worked on, in order].
  Turn it into a simple log — ordered, one line each,
  with a standout per thread. Not a highlight reel."

beats.role_note: OUTRO LAW — title restate, last beat
beats.narration_text: Two threads, one week — writing and the Loon Project, logged for real. Not the highlights. The actual work.

props.title: Two Threads, One Week: The Work Log.
